# Keeping clients informed: what the interviews say

*Researcher · sources: the three client interviews in interviews/*

## In short

Clients trust us on dates, and they want to hear from us *before* a date is in doubt, not after. Two of the three
asked for something we do not do today.

## What each source says

| Point | Source | How strong |
|-------|--------|------------|
| We keep to the dates we agree | All three interviews | Strong: raised unprompted each time |
| A check-in halfway through a project would help | Second interview | One client, but described in detail |
| Tell us early when a date will slip | Third interview | One client |
| Weekly updates are too many | First interview | One client, said in passing |

## What this does not tell us

Three interviews with long-standing clients. They chose to stay with us, so they are more likely to be content.
The survey (RES-3) should ask newer clients the same question before we change how we work.

## Suggested next step

Try a single halfway check-in on the next two projects, and ask both clients afterwards whether it helped.
